result.stdout:
USAGE:
    tempr [prompt] [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

ARGUMENTS:
    [prompt]    The message to send. Omit to start the interactive REPL, or pipe
                stdin for headless mode                                         

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                   
    -v, --version                     Prints version information                
    -m, --model <MODEL>               Model id to use for this run (overrides   
                                      'tempr config set-model'). Run 'tempr     
                                      models' to see what your licence is       
                                      entitled to                               
        --verbose                     Print each tool call's full output, and   
                                      the token usage (prompt/completion/total, 
                                      and cost if known) after each turn        
        --json                        Emit newline-delimited JSON (one RunEvent 
                                      per line) instead of formatted text -- for
                                      scripting                                 
    -y, --yolo                        Run unattended: auto-approve file edits,  
                                      MCP calls and allow-listed commands for   
                                      this run (approval-mode=autopilot for this
                                      invocation only). On Linux its commands   
                                      run in the sandbox by default, with the   
                                      network on, so any command goes ahead;    
                                      elsewhere, commands that aren't           
                                      allow-listed are still refused without a  
                                      terminal to ask on, and ones that delete, 
                                      publish or force-push always are          
        --ask                       
[truncated]

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Add or update an MCP server. Usage: tempr mcp add <name> --cwd <dir> --env 
KEY=VALUE -- <command> args...

USAGE:
    tempr mcp add <name> <command> [args] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <name>       A short local name for this server (used to                    
                 enable/disable/remove it later)                                
    <command>    The executable to launch the server with, e.g. 'npx'           
    [args]       Arguments passed to the command, e.g. '-y                      
                 @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem .'                     

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help               Prints help information                            
        --cwd <DIR>          Working directory to launch the server process in  
                             (defaults to the current directory)                
        --env <KEY=VALUE>    Environment variable to set for the server process.
                             Repeatable, e.g. --env API_KEY=abc123
